status: D07-frozen allocation and resource policy; actual confirmatory prefixes remain outcome-blind pilot outputs
evidenceBoundary: No seed in this design has been used for a pilot, confirmatory, or replication outcome. Qualification fixtures remain a separate evidence class.

seedDerivation.algorithm: SHA-256 UTF-8 domain strings separated by one NUL byte
seedDerivation.scenario: root || NUL || stage || NUL || experiment || NUL || slot || NUL || scenario
seedDerivation.learner: root || NUL || stage || NUL || experiment || NUL || condition || NUL || slot || NUL || role || NUL || learner
seedDerivation.gateway: root || NUL || stage || NUL || experiment || NUL || condition || NUL || slot || NUL || gateway
seedDerivation.analysis: root || NUL || stage || NUL || experiment || NUL || condition || NUL || slot || NUL || analysis
seedDerivation.pairingRule: Conditions in a paired comparison share the scenario seed at a stage/experiment/slot but have distinct learner, Gateway, and analysis seeds.
seedDerivation.roleRule: baby-a and baby-b always receive distinct learner seeds.

stagePolicy.softwareQualification: May validate mechanics only; excluded from all variance, effect, confirmatory, and replication estimates.
stagePolicy.blindedPilot: Twenty slots per condition where a primary design needs variance or feasibility estimation. Pilot outcomes select N using the frozen rule and never enter confirmatory estimates.
stagePolicy.confirmatory: Use the ordered prefix selected before unblinding, followed only by ordered reserves for prespecified validity failures. No outcome-based stopping or seed replacement.
stagePolicy.replication: Uses a distinct stage domain and the frozen original N and conditions; no original or pilot seed can recur.
stagePolicy.amendment: A changed model, outcome, margin, split, or test creates a new protocol version and new root. Prior attempts remain indexed.

pilotMayTune: reserve count from the fixed ten-percent rule
tuningBudget.failedIterationRule: Preserve and report it; do not rerun the same seed into a pass.

sampleSizeRule.family: H1-H8 with H2 and H4 separate, for nine global-Holm members
sampleSizeRule.selection: For every member, use its frozen raw-scale margin and blinded-pilot upper variance bound to simulate the complete member test, composite rule, missingness, and global Holm family. Select the smallest shared candidate N whose all-required-decisions lower 95% Monte Carlo power bound is at least 0.90.
sampleSizeRule.failure: If no candidate through N=300 qualifies, do not widen a margin. Redesign prospectively or obtain a larger approved resource envelope before registration.
sampleSizeRule.reserves: ceil(0.10 * selected N) per condition; validity failures only.

allocations.allocationRule: Only the prefix selected from the E03 variance bands is attempted; 300+30 is the pre-materialized maximum pool.

replication.rule: D08 replaces the provisional 100+10 with the exact original selected N+reserves before E50 registration; all designated primary conditions are repeated.

resourceBenchmark.command: pnpm run qualify:generative-carriers with five carriers, 40 training and 12 evaluation turns
limitations: The benchmark includes build startup and local fake-chain verification.
It is a short recurrent carrier qualification, not a frozen-model or public-chain measurement.
Linear scaling is a conservative planning approximation, not a throughput guarantee.

localCeiling.allowed: software qualification, protocol checks, and explicitly labeled outcome-blind or non-confirmatory pilots that fit the ceiling
localCeiling.forbidden: claiming the ceiling can execute the complete confirmatory plus replication campaign, starting paid compute, or spending chain funds

planningAccounting.interpretation: The maximum seed pools are identifiers, not authorization to execute every slot. The full campaign exceeds the local storage and CPU ceilings before frozen-model and public-chain overhead. D08 must bind selected prefixes and an approved execution environment before registration.
